correctness.rationale: Adjunction g⊣f and f≤id give g extensive and f interior; join Frobenius with y=0 gives f(g(x))=g(x) and then g(f(x))=f(x), so the common fixed image S is the floor/ceiling target. It is a bounded sublattice closed under residual implication. The cut c=U is forced into S for any nontrivial fixed element via Boolean complement if below cut and join-Frobenius if above; otherwise S={0,1}. On each of the two Boolean tiers implication forces Boolean complements, and all finite Boolean subalgebras are unique block-union partition algebras. Cross-tier adjunction and Frobenius identities for the constructed floor/ceiling operators yield the converse. Permutation orbits classify partitions by integer block sizes. Independently direct-tested small cases (1,1),(1,2),(2,2),(2,3),(3,2) with 2,3,5,11,11 valid structures.
